name: Starfall Invocation
description: Gift a card. Destroy all creatures. If the gift was promised, return a creature card put into your graveyard this way to the battlefield under your control.
notes: First attempt found a real, high-value gap: DB$/AB$ DestroyAll (a board wipe) had zero handling at all, and ChangeZone never checked ConditionPresent$...PromisedGift (the gift_promised gate Pump/PumpAll already had). Implemented DestroyAll (and DamageAll, the symmetric damage-sweep sibling, same shape) as a new handler, and wired gift_promised into ChangeZone. Verified: node D now shows the board wipe (bf->gy, creature), node E shows cond:gift_promised cond:nontoken -- exact match. In blb-success.json.
